eu_wide.name: Erasmus+ Mobility Grant (study abroad)
eu_wide.coverage: Monthly grant approx. EUR 200-500 for 3-12 months abroad plus tuition-fee exemption at the host institution; top-ups for students with fewer opportunities.
eu_wide.eligibility: Students enrolled at a higher education institution holding an Erasmus Charter, doing a study period at a partner institution abroad.

eu_wide.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) Scholarship
eu_wide.coverage: Full scholarship: EU contribution EUR 1,400/month for up to 24 months, plus travel, installation and participation costs including health insurance.
eu_wide.eligibility: Students worldwide holding a first degree, admitted to an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master delivered by a consortium in at least three countries.

scholarships.name: DAAD Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Monthly stipend (e.g. EUR 992 students, EUR 1,300 doctoral) plus flat-rate travel allowance; not repayable.
scholarships.eligibility: Primarily international graduates, doctoral students and postdocs for study/research in Germany.

scholarships.name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
scholarships.coverage: Monthly stipend EUR 2,100 (from Jan 2026) plus international transport, insurance, housing search and cultural activities; tuition exemption for national diplomas at public institutions.
scholarships.eligibility: International (non-French) students nominated by a French institution for a master's or PhD.

scholarships.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
scholarships.provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI), ICE, Uni-Italia
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition exemption plus EUR 10,000 stipend disbursed quarterly.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of eligible listed countries, for English-taught master's in engineering, architecture/design, economics/management.

scholarships.name: DSU regional scholarship (Diritto allo Studio Universitario)
scholarships.coverage: Means-tested (ISEE): tuition exemption, accommodation, meals and annual cash grant; varies by region/income.
scholarships.eligibility: Enrolled students (Italian and international, incl. non-EU) below regional income/asset thresholds.

scholarships.name: Holland Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education / Nuffic and participating institutions
scholarships.coverage: One-time EUR 5,000 paid in the first year.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-EEA international students enrolling in a bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution.

scholarships.name: Orange Tulip Scholarship (OTS)
scholarships.provider: Nuffic Neso offices with participating institutions
scholarships.coverage: Awards varying by university, from partial tuition waivers to full tuition, some with living allowance.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of specific Neso countries admitted to a participating Dutch programme.

scholarships.name: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Covers tuition, travel, insurance and living expenses for the full programme.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants from 29 eligible developing countries admitted to selected English-taught Flemish programmes.

scholarships.name: ARES Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Covers tuition, international travel, subsistence allowance, registration, visa and insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Residents/professionals of eligible partner countries for advanced bachelor/master or continuing education.

scholarships.name: MAEC-AECID Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID)
scholarships.coverage: Depending on call: monthly stipend (~EUR 1,200), tuition contribution, travel and insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: International and Spanish graduates, mostly postgraduate; some calls target developing countries.

scholarships.name: Ernst Mach Grant
scholarships.provider: OeAD (Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation)
scholarships.coverage: Monthly grant plus insurance and travel/installation support, depending on variant.
scholarships.eligibility: PhD students, postgraduates, postdocs and young lecturers from foreign universities for short stays (not full degree).

scholarships.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Funded scholarship for research or study at Swiss universities/federal institutes; benefits vary by country/type.
scholarships.eligibility: Early-career researchers from ~180 countries with a master's, with a confirmed Swiss host supervisor.

scholarships.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition, monthly living stipend SEK 12,000, travel grant SEK 15,000, medical insurance, SI network.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of listed eligible countries with work/leadership experience, admitted to an eligible English-taught master's.

scholarships.name: Danish Government Scholarships under the Cultural Agreements
scholarships.provider: Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science
scholarships.coverage: Covers tuition and a monthly grant ~DKK 6,090 (before tax) towards living costs.
scholarships.eligibility: Highly qualified master's/PhD exchange students from eligible countries (Europe, China, Japan, Israel, Egypt, Russia).

scholarships.name: University tuition-fee scholarships / waivers
scholarships.provider: Individual Finnish universities (no national government scholarship)
scholarships.coverage: Tuition waivers 50-100%; some include relocation/living grant (e.g. University of Helsinki 100% waiver + EUR 5,000 relocation grant).
scholarships.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying students admitted to an English-taught programme; via the programme application.

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
scholarships.coverage: Stipend EUR 10,000 for one year plus a full tuition fee waiver from the host institution.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA students for one year of full-time study at NFQ level 9 or 10.

scholarships.name: Stefan Banach NAWA Scholarship Programme
scholarships.provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
scholarships.coverage: Monthly stipend PLN 2,500, tuition exemption at public universities, preparatory course (Polish track), travel allowance PLN 2,500.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of 36 Polish Aid partner countries, for full-time master's in Polish or English.

scholarships.name: Government Scholarships for Developing Countries
scholarships.coverage: Scholarship for study at Czech public HEIs in Czech or English (master's and doctoral) under development cooperation.
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of a defined list of eligible developing countries for follow-up master's and doctoral programmes.

scholarships.name: Camoes Institute Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Camoes - Instituto da Cooperacao e da Lingua
scholarships.coverage: Scholarships for Portuguese language/culture courses and, under bilateral cooperation, for higher education; paid monthly/quarterly by the Embassy.
scholarships.eligibility: Foreign students for Portuguese language/culture, and nationals of Portuguese-speaking African countries and East Timor under cooperation programmes.
